trainable: candidate SH rest only in SH3
frozen: all cleaned background values including SH3
camera_sampling: seed-0 Python Random randint pop without replacement; refill all sorted train views after each epoch; exact sequence stored per case

scoring.point_opacity: arithmetic mean of four sigmoid opacities for each candidate

diagnostics.pixel_mask: fixed union of native candidate splat support at opacity 1 for both candidates, identical for all arms/iterations
diagnostics.every_100_candidate_error: pixel-weighted L1/MSE in five prelocked largest-support training views
diagnostics.start_end_candidate_error: pixel-weighted L1/MSE in all training views
diagnostics.train_psnr: mean per-view PSNR on the first five sorted training photos
diagnostics.representative_views: locked from projected area and view direction before optimization

preflight.interpretation: Trial pixels are the candidate render influence, including native Gaussian tails. The 50cm tangent cell remains the sampling and cleanup unit.
preflight.decision_author: agent interpretation following user request to proceed; not a separately explicit user mask approval
preflight.user_steering: 이 실험의 목표가 뭔데 왜 그냥 서있는거야?

resource_recovery: resume exact saved optimizer/parameters/RNG and fixed camera sequence; no sample downscale or algorithm change
